title: When the Blue Hour Sings
author: Wren Sandoval
blurb: Wren Okonkwo, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
